scenario_config.prompt: We're opening a new regional office in Berlin, Germany to support our European expansion, and I need the full IT setup put in place. Please create a new active location for our Berlin office at Plot 42, Friedrichstrasse, Berlin, Germany. We're appointing Sarah Mueller as the team lead, she'll be a manager and should have an active account with the email sarah.mueller@techcorp.com and phone number +49-309-550-0201, and she should be based at the Berlin location. We also need to onboard three support agents: Lars Jensen (lars.jensen@techcorp.com, +49-305-550-0202), Dmitri Volkov (dmitri.volkov@techcorp.com, +49-305-550-0203), and Yuki Tanaka (yuki.tanaka@techcorp.com, +49-305-550-0204), all with active accounts and complete details assigned to the Berlin office. Please create a new active user group called 'Berlin Support Team' with a small description for IT Support, set the group email to berlin-support@techcorp.com, assign Sarah Mueller as the manager, and add the three agents as group members. Finally, register two configuration items for the Berlin office: a laptop called 'Sarah Manager Laptop' with serial number LAPTOP-BER-MGR-001, assigned to Sarah, marked as in use, with a cost of 1800.00, and an under maintenance server called 'Berlin Email Relay Server' with serial number SERVER-BER-RELAY-001, assigned to me (Marcus Thompson), with a cost of 8500.00.

verifier_configs.name: verify_berlin_location_created
verifier_configs.description: Verify Berlin location was created and is active
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location WHERE city = 'Berlin' AND country = 'Germany' AND street = 'Friedrichstrasse' AND plot_no = '42' AND active = 1 AND org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_sarah_mueller_created
verifier_configs.description: Verify Sarah Mueller manager account was created with correct updated phone
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = 'sarah.mueller@techcorp.com' AND role = 'manager' AND phone = '+49-309-550-0201' AND (user_name = 'sarah.mueller' OR user_name IS NOT NULL) AND active = 1 AND org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_three_agents_created
verifier_configs.description: Verify three agent accounts were created for Berlin team
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email IN ('lars.jensen@techcorp.com', 'dmitri.volkov@techcorp.com', 'yuki.tanaka@techcorp.com') AND phone IN ('+49-305-550-0202', '+49-305-550-0203', '+49-305-550-0204') AND role = 'agent' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND active = 1 AND org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_berlin_support_team_created
verifier_configs.description: Verify Berlin Support Team group was created with updated description
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group WHERE name = 'Berlin Support Team' AND type = 'IT Support' AND email = 'berlin-support@techcorp.com' AND description IS NOT NULL AND active = 1 AND org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_sarah_is_group_manager
verifier_configs.description: Verify Sarah Mueller is set as manager of Berlin Support Team
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group ug JOIN users u ON ug.manager_id = u.user_id WHERE ug.name = 'Berlin Support Team' AND u.email = 'sarah.mueller@techcorp.com' AND ug.org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_three_group_members_added
verifier_configs.description: Verify three agents were added as members of Berlin Support Team
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member ugm JOIN users u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id JOIN user_group ug ON ugm.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE ug.name = 'Berlin Support Team' AND u.email IN ('lars.jensen@techcorp.com', 'dmitri.volkov@techcorp.com', 'yuki.tanaka@techcorp.com') AND ugm.org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_two_cis_registered
verifier_configs.description: Verify two configuration items were registered for Berlin office
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item ci JOIN location l ON ci.location_id = l.location_id WHERE ci.serial_number IN ('LAPTOP-BER-MGR-001', 'SERVER-BER-RELAY-001') AND ci.cost IN (1800, 8500) AND l.name = 'Berlin Office' AND ci.org_id = 'ORG_001';

verifier_configs.name: verify_server_in_maintenance
verifier_configs.description: Verify Berlin Email Relay Server status was updated to MAINTENANCE
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item WHERE serial_number = 'SERVER-BER-RELAY-001' AND status = 'maintenance' AND org_id = 'ORG_001';
